name: FPV Drone Flythrough
description: A fast low flythrough on a wide lens in one unbroken take. Seedance 2.5 through OpenRouter holds a longer take together.
prompt: FPV drone flies fast and low through {{subject}}, banks around obstacles, wide lens, continuous single take, wind sound, {{extra}}
negative_prompt: cuts, stutter, tripod stillness, morphing, text

slots.name: subject
slots.label: Subject
slots.help: What the drone flies through, e.g. 'the derelict warehouse'.

slots.name: extra
slots.label: Anything else
slots.default: keep the light of the still

author: kilnry
